assets.name: Spikey
assets.prompt: Create ONE production 2D top-down enemy sprite PNG for a small neon tower-defense game. Genuine transparent alpha background, no black background, no checkerboard painted into image. Square canvas 1024x1024, sprite centered, occupies about 65% of canvas width and height, entire outline visible with wide empty transparent margins. Orthographic straight top-down view, front faces exactly upward (north), bilateral symmetry except organic detailing. Graphic luminous arcade style with strong simple silhouette, dark interior and restrained colored rim accents, thick readable features. Only 3-6 major shapes; clean soft-shaded dimensional forms, not photorealistic, no tiny texture or greebles. Must read clearly when reduced to 32 pixels. Restrained saturation and narrow colored highlights; avoid large white areas or baked-in fuzzy glow because the game supplies bloom. No text, no letters, no labels, no border, no surrounding circle or square, no energy bubble, no scenery or cast shadow. This is a single standalone sprite, not a sheet. A hostile amber spiked mine organism. A compact dark rust central sphere surrounded by exactly eight broad sharp radial golden-orange spikes, two slightly longer front spikes. Silhouette must unmistakably be a spiny starburst, not an arrowhead. Large black negative gaps between spikes, glowing amber edges, a small orange central eye.

assets.name: ShieldBubble
assets.prompt: Generate ONE reusable 2D game VFX sprite PNG: an empty spherical energy-shield bubble overlay, exactly circular and centered in a square 1024x1024 canvas, outer diameter 80% of canvas. Genuine transparent alpha background and genuinely transparent center; only a faint cyan-blue glass membrane, thin luminous continuous cyan rim, one soft broad curved reflection in the upper-left quadrant and one much fainter lower-right reflection. It must look like a delicate soap bubble made of energy, not a solid ball, not concentric stacked rings, not a helmet. Center at least 90% transparent so a game character drawn underneath remains clearly visible. Smooth translucent edge transitions and antialiasing, a little rim thickness so it survives reduction to 50 pixels. Keep glow restrained and narrow because the game supplies bloom. No objects inside, no text, no labels, no checkerboard baked in, no black or white background, no cast shadow, no scenery. Save as transparent PNG.
